description: Na₂O is Cotunnite-like structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of three Na₂O sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond length. O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven Na atoms.
